## 株式会社ドリームブロッサム
403 subscribers

### Description
381 views
Posted: 21 Oct 2025
遊びを超える、シューティング体験。

高精度ダーツと多彩なラインアップで、誰でもヒーローになれる最強のシューティングトイ！
エックスショットのエクセルシリーズは、遠くまで届くパワーとスピードを両立した進化系ブラスター。 [...] XShot Hawkeye. Fire up to 90 ft up your game with XShot Hawkeye from Zero. Introducing the new XShot rink. [Music] Easy to assemble out of pack. [Music] Plenty of darts in case you loosen mid battle. It's a singleshot revolving power. It's even slam fire and great distance. Introducing the XShot XL Caliber. But wait, I didn't know you guys were doing XL. Look. Yes, we're doing XL range. I don't think we'll ever stop. Look, they're all great blasters, especially the caliber. This one's sick. [...] This one's sick. Anyways, let me show you why we call this one the caliber. And you know, straight out of pack, this actually feels really, really sturdy. Let's go try it out. Wait for it. Miss, miss, miss. Jump shot. Got him. Pretty accurate. Oh, and I forgot to mention the distance on this bad boy is pretty insane for a singleshot revolving blaster. Part of the XL range. Nice.
